apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: No more zooming: double-tap and pinch zoom are off, and fields no longer zoom when tapped.
Pick a quick one: every drill, most overdue first, split into Boot on and Boot off.

Settings panel (gear, top right): voice and speed, cues and volume, haptics, reminder times and quick-one cadence, which drills rotate, weight, export/import. Reminders no longer pop while the app is open.
